name: 道の駅 筑前みなみの里
desc: 福岡県筑前町にある道の駅「筑前みなみの里」は、のどかな農村風景に癒される人気スポットです。最大の特徴は、薪と羽釜で炊いたご飯や手作りの「筑前煮」が味わえる農村レストラン。ヤギやウサギと触れ合えるコーナーもあり家族連れで賑わいます。特産品は、大粒の黒大豆「筑前クロダマル」や幻の柑橘「木酢（きず）」。直売所には毎朝採れたての野菜が並び、豊かな自然とどこか懐かしい田舎の味を堪能できます。
descEn: Located in Chikuzen Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Chikuzen Minami-no-Sato" is a popular spot where visitors can relax in a peaceful rural landscape. Its greatest feature is the rural restaurant, where you can savor rice cooked in a traditional wood-fired kamado pot alongside handmade "Chikuzen-ni" (simmered chicken and vegetables). Families can also enjoy the petting area with goats and other animals. Local specialties include large black soybeans known as "Chikuzen Kurodamaru" and a rare citrus fruit called "Kizu." With the farmers' market stocked daily with freshly harvested vegetables, it is a wonderful place to fully enjoy abundant nature and nostalgic country flavors.
